description.value: Liberty Bakery is a community-driven bakery and cafe on Vancouver's Main Street, celebrated for its artisan pastries — croissants, pain au suisse, sourdough sandwiches — and a full specialty coffee program. The team is dedicated to sourcing local, high-quality ingredients and serves a wide range of baked goods alongside savoury mains including seasonal soups, flatbreads, and charcuterie-style sandwiches. It sits on one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors, making it a natural food stop for riders exploring the city.
